prompt:
You are an experienced sommelier comparing two wine recommenders. A
customer with no wine knowledge made this request:

"It is freezing tonight, so I am looking for a light wine that everyone always likes."

List A:
Wine 1: Black Muscat, US, $18. Tasting note: "A plummy, semi-sweet dark red wine that could stand a bit of a chill in the fridge. It has a nice chocolatey edge that would be a good partner with dark chocolate desserts. Finishes clean and with good acidity."
Wine 2: Rosé, France, $8. Tasting note: "This wine is soft and light. It has a gentle fruity character, with soft acidity. Well chilled on a hot day, this will be refreshing."
Wine 3: Pinot Blanc, Austria, $19. Tasting note: "This is a light, bright wine with flavors of green fruits and citrus. There is a hint of yeastiness. Overall, a cool feeling wine that is ready to drink. Screwcap."
Wine 4: Portuguese White, Portugal, $5. Tasting note: "A sweet, soft, clean wine, anonymous almost. Yes, there is freshness, lightness, but all the time the awkward, unbalancing sweetness pulls it down. Drink very chilled."
Wine 5: Portuguese Red, Portugal, $7. Tasting note: "This is a cool, light wine. It has stalky black fruits and tannins that come from the fruit skins. It is a wine to drink almost as an apéritif: light and fruity at the end."

List B:
Wine 1: Merlot, US, $19. Tasting note: "A modest wine that has much to be modest about. It's dry and rather simple, with candied cherry-berry, cola and spice flavors."
Wine 2: Cabernet Sauvignon, US, $90. Tasting note: "If you're looking for sheer flash in Napa Valley Cabernet, try this one. It's expensive, but worth the price. It dazzles for soft lusciousness, and the depth and complexity of blackberries, black currants, cassis and chocolate, as well as the perfect integration of new French oak. Yet the wine, which contains a splash of Malbec, is dry and balanced in acidity and velvety tannins. Great now, and will continue to please through 2022."
Wine 3: Bordeaux-style White Blend, France, $13. Tasting note: "A light wine that seems rather dilute. It has simple, green and citrus fruit flavors that are gentle and refreshing. Drink now."
Wine 4: Meritage, US, $18. Tasting note: "Here's a rich, smooth wine for drinking now. It's softly luscious, packed with blackberry, cherry, anise and cedar flavors that finish with quite a bit of complexity."
Wine 5: Portuguese White, Portugal, $13. Tasting note: "This is the lightest in a series of wines featuring the Avesso grape. Herbal, crisp and with plenty of acidity, it's also fruity and ready to drink."

Which list answers the request better as a whole: relevance to every wish,
variety where the request leaves room, and fit for any occasion? If they
are equally good, say tie. Think briefly, then answer with JSON only:
{"reason": "<two sentences at most>", "better": "A" | "B" | "tie"}
